description: DiligenceOps: submit documentation (text, or a public HTTPS url) and the current_version. The signed report counts and briefly quotes mentions of older and newer version numbers, including /v1/ style paths, and the endpoints, parameters and functions the text itself marks deprecated, with how often each is still named elsewhere in the text. POST /api/docs-freshness-check. Reads the supplied text, or one public HTTPS page read once with GET (no redirects, public DNS only, 512 KB): no account access, no merchant contact and no money movement. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. The report matches words, figures, dates and named items between the submitted texts; it does not interpret meaning beyond that matching. Contract: /api/diligence-evidence-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/diligence-checks/.

inputSchema.description: Send exactly one of text or url.

current_version.description: The product version the documentation should describe, for example "3.2.0".

format.description: html reduces the markup to readable text first. Defaults to html when the text starts with a tag, otherwise text.

text.description: The documentation as plain text, Markdown or HTML, up to 256 KB.

url.description: A public HTTPS documentation page, read once with GET, no redirects, up to 512 KB.

name: wever_docs-freshness-check
title: Docs freshness check
